name: Get Activity Types
summary: Lists every activity type in your instance with its ID — the IDs you need to filter activities (e.g. only 'Web Page Views', only 'Data Value Changes').
whenToUse: Run this first when working with activities: it gives you the type IDs to pass to 'Get Lead Activities'.

response.description: Array of activity types: id, name, and definitions (primary attribute, etc.).
